intent: After lunch, continue checking appointments in the calendar I left open.
actions: Sign in as an administrator with Calendar and Message Center loaded in a single browser tab and normal background reminder polling active. The reproduction environment sets the idle timeout to 5 seconds to shorten the wait.
Leave the calendar open without interacting with or refreshing the page. Wait for the session to expire naturally and allow two normal reminder polling cycles.
Return to the calendar. If Week is still available, try switching to the week view.
If a sign-in option appears, sign in again with valid credentials and confirm that you can continue viewing the calendar.
